summary: Iteration 3: Verified new Motor Insurance feature end-to-end + full regression. Backend: 60/60 pytest pass (53 regression + 7 new motor tests). Motor pricing math exactly matches spec ($1050 gross -> -$262.50 NCD -> -$78.75 online rebate -> $35 addon -> +8% tax -> $803.25 with single Windscreen addon; $835.65 matches when both Windscreen + Flood addons per expected calc). Frontend: /products/motor-easy marketing page renders hero, 'Motor Easy' chip, 5 benefit cards, 6 addon cards, 6 FAQ accordions, Buy Now navigates to /motor-quote/{productId}; 3-step stepper, all Step0 fields + privacy checkbox present; Step1 cover/sum_insured/ncd/addons work; Step2 summary displays gross premium $1050, NCD -$262.50 (25%), online rebate -$78.75 (10%), addons $35, SST $59.50, total $803.25; Pay securely button successfully redirects to checkout.stripe.com. Regression: landing page motor tile -> /products/motor-easy (verified), products page get-quote-motor-btn -> /products/motor-easy (verified authenticated), travel quote /quote/{id} still works (verified), login + dashboard still work.

issues: Continue-to-plan button uses CSS-only disabled styling (opacity/grey) — no HTML `disabled` attribute nor aria-disabled on motor-step0-next; click may still fire onClick handler. Recommend adding disabled attribute when fields/consent incomplete for accessibility + Playwright-testability.

action_items: Minor a11y: Add HTML `disabled` attribute (not just CSS greying) to motor-step0-next button while fields/consent incomplete, to prevent accidental clicks & improve screen-reader support.
Consider adding a /products/motor-easy public-access guard check: currently /products page redirects anonymous users to /login, so landing CTA flow for anonymous users is one extra click.
critical_code_review_comments: Motor pricing in /app/backend/routers/quotes.py correctly implements spec: base = max(product.base, sum*0.035), age loading, NCD%, 10% online rebate on (base-NCD), addons+tax. Math verified against expected $835.65 (both addons) and $803.25 (Windscreen only).
seed.py adds 'Motor Easy' with all 7 addons idempotently (category+name match) — verified.

MotorQuote.jsx correctly uses data-testids matching spec (motor-step-0..2, account-personal/business, id-type-nric/passport, vehicle-reg-input, motor-step0-next, cover-comprehensive/third_party, motor-addon-*, motor-get-quote-btn, motor-pay-btn).
AIChat toggle visible at bottom-left — fix from iteration 2 confirmed; no overlap with Emergent badge.

Consider exposing /products/motor-easy and other marketing pages without auth so anonymous users can read product details and then hit login only at the purchase step (UX aligned with tuneprotect.com original).
seed_data_creation: Verified Motor Easy product is auto-seeded on backend boot with 7 add-ons. Motor quote + checkout session created successfully for demo user. Test quote id persisted to DB and retrievable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 3 adds Motor Insurance feature (marketing + 3-step quote + Stripe checkout). All tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass (60 total). Motor-specific tests are in classes TestMotorProducts and TestMotorQuote. Frontend flow verified end-to-end: /products/motor-easy -> Buy Now -> /motor-quote/{id} -> fill step0 (account/personal info) -> step1 (cover/sum/ncd/addons) -> step2 (summary) -> Pay securely -> checkout.stripe.com. Math: $30k sum with 25% NCD and Windscreen addon = $803.25; with Windscreen+Flood = $835.65. Known minor: motor-step0-next uses CSS-only disabled state (no HTML disabled attr).
rca of the issue: No bugs found this iteration; all Motor features work as specified.
